caption: The drawing depicts a single white pitcher with a wide spout and an angular handle on the right side. The pitcher features a painted floral design on its front, consisting of a large pink rose at the center surrounded by green, brown, and yellow leaves. The handle and the rim of the pitcher are shaded with gray tones, giving a sense of three-dimensionality. The overall background is a plain, light beige color, and the pitcher is centered within a lightly drawn rectangular frame. There is a stamped mark in the upper left corner and the signature "Jos Sudek" is written in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
